mentions.name: Halo vision headphones
mentions.description: Halo vision headphones, a wearable hardware product combining headphones with video capture. The build was just published and is being refined to reduce the number of parts, tune audio quality, and improve video stabilization.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just published the Halo vision headphones [1]. Currently working on reducing parts where possible, tuning audio quality and video stabilization.
